incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-3892 fired for metering-usage-checkpoint-lag at 2025-06-12T09:13:09Z

pagerduty: [ALERT] metering-usage-checkpoint-lag - service: metering-ingest - Triggered on prod (severity: P1)

jamie: acked. I'm oncall, jumping in. Ravi, can you join? @ravi

ravi: on it. seeing consumer lag on topic usage-events, partitions 0-11. offsets stalled ~120s behind.

linh: noticed spikes in token-count diffs in last 20m, looks like a downstream write retry loop. logs: ```consumer.consume() -> commitTimeout``` 

sarah: customers generating invoices from last 2 hours may be missing tokens. Risk: invoice blockers for daily billing runs. Need triage.

jamie: quick plan: 1) mute noisy alerts, 2) scale up metering-consumer to 6 replicas, 3) replay backlog to repair token counts, 4) notify finance.

billing-team: oncall finance here. Please give ETA, how many customers affected? Any manual mitigation (pause invoice run)?

ravi: estimating ~3.2M tokens undercount across 34 accounts. If we don't fix within 90m invoice calc will be inaccurate for today. Recommend pausing overnight invoice job.

jamie: pausing daily-invoice-run now. @billing-team confirm you can accept manual run tomorrow after replay.

billing-team: confirmed. we'll hold and prepare manual reconciliation. :+1:

linh: scaling consumers now: `kubectl scale deployment/metering-consumer --replicas=6 -n prod` -> pods creating. tailing logs to ensure commits resume.

ravi: found root cause: kafka client backpressure due to slow external DB writes (token-aggregation store). Applying mitigation: enabling local batching and temporary bypass to write fast-path. Patch: `ENABLE_FASTPATH=true` on metering-writer.

jamie: applying patch to canary instance, rolling: `kubectl set env deployment/metering-writer ENABLE_FASTPATH=true -n prod` -> canary healthy.

sarah: monitoring token reconciliation metric. Replay job started: `python tools/replay_tokens.py --from-offset 123456789 --to-latest` . ETA ~40m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-3892 acknowledged by jamie

pagerduty: Escalation scheduled in 30m if no progress. If any customer escalations, tag #customer-success.

jamie: leaving handoff notes for next oncall (ravi taking next shift at 10:00Z). Next actions: watch replay progress, ensure reconciliation success, don't unpause invoice-run until billing-team confirms.

ravi: ack handoff. will follow up with a postmortem draft. adding runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-ingest>

billing-team: shout when replay done and we can resume invoice generation. keep finance looped.

jamie: incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2123 created. Severity: SEV2 (billing impact but manual hold mitigates immediate customer harm). Will update channel with finish timestamp.

linh: replay finished at 2025-06-12T09:54:32Z. reconciliation delta within tolerance. starting validation checks.

ravi: validation passed. notifying billing to resume nightly job. tagging finance: @billing-team

billing-team: resuming job now. thanks all. :rocket:

jamie: incident resolved. closing PagerDuty: P-3892

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident P-3892 resolved by jamie
